parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: Diabetes insipidus (DI) is a condition in humans that causes a person to have an excessive thirst, which leads to increased drinking. One form of DI is caused by a tumour in the region of the hypothalamus concerned with osmoregulation.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Explain how a tumour develops in the hypothalamus.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest how a tumour in the hypothalamus can lead to a person producing a large volume of dilute urine.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The nervous and endocrine systems of a mammal co-ordinate responses to changes in the internal and external environment. Table 2.1 compares some features of the nervous and endocrine systems.

Complete Table 2.1.

Table 2.1

| feature | nervous system | endocrine system |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| signal | impulse | ........................................ |
| method of transmission of signal | ........................................ | in blood |
| type of communication | ........................................ | chemical |
| duration of effect | ........................................ | ........................................ |
